title: Valid Palindrome

statement.hi: Ek string `s` di hai. Saare uppercase letters ko lowercase karo aur saare non-alphanumeric characters hata do. Agar bachi hui string aage aur peeche se same padhi jaati hai (palindrome) to `true` return karo, warna `false`.
statement.en: Given a string `s`, convert all uppercase letters to lowercase and remove all non-alphanumeric characters. Return `true` if the resulting string reads the same forward and backward (a palindrome), otherwise `false`.

constraints: s consists only of printable ASCII characters

hi: Nayi string banaye bina kaam ho sakta hai — do pointers, ek shuru se ek end se.
Non-alphanumeric characters ko skip karo, aur compare karte waqt dono ko lowercase karo.
en: You can do it without building a new string — two pointers, one from each end.
Skip non-alphanumeric characters and compare both sides in lowercase.

args: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

explain.hi: Saaf karne ke baad "amanaplanacanalpanama" palindrome hai.
Saaf karne ke baad string khaali hai, aur khaali string palindrome hai.
explain.en: After cleaning the string is empty, and an empty string is a palindrome.

approach.hi: Do pointers `i = 0`, `j = n-1`. Jab tak `i < j`: non-alphanumeric chars skip karo, phir `tolower(s[i])` aur `tolower(s[j])` compare karo; mismatch pe `false`. Extra string nahi banti. O(n) time, O(1) space.
approach.en: Two pointers `i = 0`, `j = n-1`. While `i < j`: skip non-alphanumeric characters, then compare `tolower(s[i])` and `tolower(s[j])`; any mismatch means `false`. No extra string is built. O(n) time, O(1) space.
